notes: Wall-clock agent time: started_at is ms since epoch, seconds 1..604800, and the run may not end in the future. The owner's client adds it as a time entry with actor "agent", never counted in the owner's own total. request_id (optional, a UUID the client generates once per intended write) makes a retry safe: the same request_id with the same body from the same connection returns the original response and applies nothing; the same request_id with a different body is refused with receipt_collision.
